format: LLVM IR instrumentation profile text, dense counts
normalization: Replace M:/ with @KAIRO_SOURCE@/ in LLVM text export; restore actual root before llvm-profdata merge. Counts and hashes are unchanged; named indirect targets are rehashed by LLVM. Canonical text uses LF with one final newline.
mergePolicy: Equal input weights; dense llvm-profdata merge. Only three explicit accepted paths. Rejected atomic Doom and all held-out workloads excluded.
limitations: Non-atomic training counters; unequal full-session durations; Quake calibration wait. Held-out data excluded.
contents: Native compiler function names, CFG hashes, counters and value profiles only; no guest executables, game data, saved drives or artwork.
